name: Sara Balloo
summary: In Ironforge's Military Ward, Sara Balloo grieves for Sully and holds to the words he left behind.

sections.title: A Widow's Vigil
sections.body: Sara Balloo keeps vigil in Ironforge's Military Ward, where weapons ring and soldiers drill. Her husband, Sully Balloo, fell in battle far from home, leaving her with grief and memories. A final letter crossed the mountains from the place where he died. Sully's words from his last days bring Sara some measure of closure.

sections.title: A Cry for Remembrance
sections.body: Sara Balloo wants Sully's sacrifice remembered. She appeals to King Magni Bronzebeard to honor Sully and the other fallen soldiers from the throne. She wants the cost borne by ordinary dwarven families to be remembered.

faq.answer: Sara Balloo lives in Ironforge's Military Ward. She is the widow of Sully Balloo, a dwarven soldier who fell in battle.

faq.q: Where can I find Sara Balloo?
faq.answer: You can find Sara Balloo in Ironforge's Military Ward, near the training grounds and barracks.
Sully Balloo died during military service. An adventurer recovered his belongings and a final waterlogged letter after they had been lost.

faq.q: What does Sara do with Sully's letter?
faq.answer: After reading Sully's heartfelt words, Sara writes to King Magni Bronzebeard and asks him to recognize and remember Sully's sacrifice.

angles.text: As a dwarf passing through Ironforge's Military Ward, you can see in Sara Balloo the toll on families whose kin defend Khaz Modan.
As an Alliance soldier, you see how news can bring closure to a fallen soldier's family. Battles across Azeroth wound those at home.
